description: On Day 11 we made a premise KNOWN once it had one source you can open. Today's question is the natural next one: when one source isn't enough, what actually counts as a second?
line: A critical premise has three agreeing sources, but all three copy one page ("minor units, e.g. 1000 = 10.00 EUR", read as divide by 100); when JPY is enabled later, every JPY payout is booked at 1/100 of its value
title: Day 12 — Same Source Twice
